audit.whatIsWrong: The page claims Null Sphere's shield 'only blocks one instance' / 'only eats one hit'. Riot's text says it absorbs MAGIC damage. Sett deals physical and true damage, so the shield absorbs nothing he does — the page understates his early kill pressure and teaches the wrong reason. Nether Blade's auto-attack reset was absent entirely.
audit.why: Kassadin Q: 'The excess energy forms around himself, granting a temporary shield that absorbs magic damage.' Nether Blade (W, flat 7s) is flagged autoReset and empowers his next basic attack — the wind-up is the burst tell. Riftwalk is 5/3.5/2s and its cost escalates on rapid recasts, so mana, not cooldown, is the real limiter.
audit.corrected: Null Sphere's shield is magic-damage-only and stops none of Sett's damage. Nether Blade is an auto reset — react to the wind-up, not the cast. Riftwalk 5s at rank 1, punished through mana; Force Pulse 21s at rank 1.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns carried no numbers at all — just 'his mobility spike at 6'.
audit.why: Riftwalk's raw 5s cooldown makes 'wait for it to be down' useless advice; the mana escalation on repeat casts is the actual punishable window, and Force Pulse at 21s rank 1 is the long one.
audit.corrected: Riftwalk 5s at rank 1, mana-limited on repeats; Force Pulse 21s at rank 1.
